front: When did the Manchurian crisis begin?

back: The Japanese puppet state set up in Manchuria in 1932 under Puyi.

front: What did the Lytton Report conclude?
back: Japan had acted wrongly and Manchuria should be returned to Chinese rule (October 1932).
Secret British-French plan (December 1935) to give Italy much of Abyssinia; its leak discredited the League.

front: Why did sanctions against Italy fail?
back: Oil was excluded, the Suez Canal stayed open, Britain and France wanted Italy as an ally, the USA was outside, and the war was short.

front: How did the Depression weaken the League?
back: It encouraged aggressive nationalism in Japan, Italy and Germany and made Britain and France unwilling to lose trade through sanctions.

front: When did Japan, Germany and Italy leave the League?
back: Japan and Germany announced it in 1933; Italy in 1937.

front: When did Haile Selassie address the League?
back: June 1936, in Geneva, after Italy took Addis Ababa.
